verses.decoded: Someone ran to get a sponge, soaked it in vinegar, put it on a stick, and gave it to him to drink, saying, 'Wait, let's see if Elijah comes to save him.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
verses.decoded: Jesus shouted loudly and then died.

verses.kjv: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.decoded: The curtain in the temple tore in two from top to bottom.

verses.kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verses.decoded: The Roman officer standing near saw Jesus die and said, 'This man really was the Son of God.'

verses.kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
verses.decoded: Some women were watching from a distance, including Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and Joses, and Salome.

verses.kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: These women had followed Jesus in Galilee and helped him, along with many other women who came to Jerusalem with him.

verses.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.decoded: It was evening, the day before the Sabbath, which was the day to prepare for the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
verses.decoded: Joseph of Arimathea, a respected member of the council who was waiting for God's kingdom, boldly asked Pilate for Jesus' body.

verses.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
verses.decoded: Pilate was surprised Jesus was already dead and asked the officer if Jesus had been dead for some time.

verses.kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
verses.decoded: After the officer confirmed Jesus was dead, Pilate gave the body to Joseph.

verses.kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
verses.decoded: Joseph bought fine linen, took Jesus down from the cross, wrapped him in the linen, placed him in a tomb cut out of rock, and rolled a stone in front of the tomb's entrance.

verses.kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
verses.decoded: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses watched where Jesus was laid.

verses.kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.decoded: After the Sabbath ended, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices to anoint Jesus' body.

verses.kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.decoded: Early on the first day of the week, just as the sun was rising, they went to the tomb.

verses.kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.decoded: They wondered among themselves, 'Who will roll away the stone from the tomb's entrance for us?'

verses.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.decoded: When they looked, they saw the large stone had already been rolled away.

verses.kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.decoded: They went into the tomb and saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a long white robe, and they were scared.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verses.decoded: He told them, 'Don't be afraid. You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is alive; he is not here. Look where they laid him.'

verses.kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Go and tell Jesus' followers and Peter that Jesus is going ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just like he told you.'

verses.kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
verses.decoded: The women left the tomb quickly, trembling and amazed. They were too afraid to say anything to anyone.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
verses.decoded: Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus rose from the dead, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

verses.kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.decoded: She went and told the people who had been with Jesus, but they were sad and crying.

verses.kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.decoded: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.

verses.kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.decoded: Later, Jesus appeared in a different way to two of them while they were walking in the country.

verses.kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.decoded: They told the others, but those people did not believe them either.

verses.kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
verses.decoded: After that, Jesus appeared to the eleven disciples while they were eating and scolded them for not believing the people who had seen him after he rose from the dead.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them to go everywhere in the world and share the good news with everyone.

verses.kjv: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.decoded: Anyone who believes and is baptized will be saved, but anyone who does not believe will be lost.

verses.kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.decoded: These signs will happen to those who believe: they will cast out demons in my name and speak in new languages.

verses.kjv: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.decoded: They will handle snakes safely, and if they drink something deadly, it will not hurt them. They will also place their hands on sick people, and those people will get better.

verses.kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.decoded: After Jesus said these things, he was taken up to heaven and sat at God's right side.

verses.kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
verses.decoded: The disciples went out and preached everywhere, with the Lord helping them and showing that their message was true through miracles. Amen.
